request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
Until when can I say no to the bank's new account fee?

response.text:
You don't need to "say no" actively — but if you want to reject the fee increase, you should act by the consent deadline of **Mon 30 Nov 2026** [item:itm_9qzfwbhh5m74].

- The bank (Musterbank eG) wants your explicit consent to raise the Girokonto Klassik fee; simply not consenting counts as declining [item:itm_9qzfwbhh5m74].
- If you don't consent, the bank says it may terminate the account with two months' notice — but you can also cancel it yourself free of charge at any time [item:itm_9qzfwbhh5m74].
- You can decide/respond in Ordnung under "Draft letter" or mark the to-do once handled.

Sehr geehrter Herr Rivera,

seit vielen Jahren haben wir die Preise für unsere Kontomodelle stabil gehalten. Gestiegene Kosten für
IT-Sicherheit und Zahlungsverkehr machen nun eine Anpassung erforderlich. Für Ihr Girokonto Klassik

kündigen.
